title: Post-tag: read changed file paths as raw bytes so non-UTF-8 and NFD names do not exit 7 (DEC-299 a6)
description: opum-doc DEC-299 (a6), arm A for 0.1.0: a changed file whose name is not valid UTF-8, or an NFD-composed name where the platform normalizes, makes the whole code map exit 7 (src/codemap.ts decodes git -z output as UTF-8, so the path is mangled and its diff -- <path> reads empty, which the (a5) guard now reports as indeterminate); the README's limits state it. Real fix, post-tag, in two steps: (1) read paths as raw bytes, keeping git -z output as a Buffer and not UTF-8 decoding it, so such a file reads correctly; (2) only if a path still cannot be read, degrade to a named per-file omission with a designed omission kind instead of failing the map. NOT STARTED; held until after the tag.
